{{Quote|Two days ago, your rival bounty hunter shot down Tyresius's ship over Tatooine but then lost him in the desert.|[[Crysta Markon]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:TTT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Tatooine Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref>}}
A '''starship''' was owned by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] scoundrel [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:CASE" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Lokai became a target of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] and his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was shot down over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TOR:TTT" /> by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Veeboo Lunx]]. Tyresius bribed Lunx into abandoning the Hunt<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref> and tried to escape the planet under an alias, but was pursued by another [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] across the [[Dune Sea]] desert. Eventually, Lokai was cornered at his ship's landing cite, where he persuaded the Hunter into letting him live by presenting a genetically identical clone to claim his bounty. Changing his name to Gault Rennow, Lokai left on the Hunter's [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]], abandoning his ship on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:CASE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyresius Lokai's starship appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:CASE" />
